title: Squenched Avacausage
description: Squenched Avacausage is a Doom II megawad by nova++ featuring 19 maps, an outro level, and a bonus level. Journey through the strange world of SquenchCon International Food-Similar Products Ltd. across office buildings, factories, trains, and the ocean floor. The set features a strong focus on environmental storytelling, chapter-based progression, modified monsters, and renamed weapons.
